recipes.name: Moon Cheese Nuggets
recipes.desc: Six cratered Moon Cheese nuggets, breaded and fried until they glow faintly, with a ranch 'crater dip'. One small bite for a customer, one giant leap for snacks.
steps: Bread ING_MOON_CHEESE in ING_FLOUR, ING_EGG and ING_PANKO; fry and shake once (it floats a little).
Plate around a ING_RANCH crater dip.
cx: The craters are too shallow. The moon has DEEP craters.
It's not glowing. Did you buy Earth cheese?
recipes.look: Six golden nuggets with crater dimples and a faint pale-yellow glow around a ranch dip shaped like a crater.
recipes.anim: Nuggets drift upward 0.1 studs and settle (low-gravity bob, prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Faint lunar glow and tiny star twinkles.
recipes.mut: Space Chef cuts alien CHOP taps by 1 for `alien`/`cosmic` chefs (`MUT_033` Alien Grey Head, `MUT_210` Moon Boots); Kitchen Pro on the fry.

recipes.name: Zero-Gravity Noodles
recipes.desc: Silver noodles float-fried in the Anti-Gravity Wok and served hovering above the bowl with soy-sautéed vegetables. Chopsticks optional; a net is recommended.
steps: Sauté ING_GARLIC, ING_BELL_PEPPER and ING_MUSHROOM with ING_SOY_SAUCE.
Float-fry ING_ZERO_G_NOODLES; nudge them back before they drift out.
Bowl: ING_ZERO_G_NOODLES hovering over ING_BELL_PEPPER, ING_MUSHROOM and ING_GARLIC with ING_SOY_SAUCE.
cx: My noodles floated to table six. They're happier there.
Not zero gravity — LOW gravity. I can tell.
recipes.look: A bowl with shimmering silver noodles hovering 0.3 studs above it in a loose swirl, veggies below.
recipes.anim: Noodles drift in a slow orbit; customer slurps them out of the air (ANM_043 upward variant).
recipes.vfx: Sparkle trail around the floating noodles (Reduced Effects: static hover).
recipes.mut: Space Chef widens the FLOAT window; `ABL_069` Hover Serve carries it without the noodles escaping; `MUT_210` Moon Boots chefs get a 'feels like home' bark.

recipes.name: Crater Crêpes
recipes.desc: Paper-thin crêpes of Crater Flour that bubble into little craters as they cook, folded around Moon Cheese, strawberries and chocolate.
steps: Swirl thin ING_CRATER_FLOUR crêpes (with ING_EGG and ING_MILK) until they crater; one flip.
ING_CRATER_FLOUR crêpe, ING_MOON_CHEESE, ING_STRAWBERRY, ING_CHOCOLATE, ING_WHIPPED_CREAM; fold into a moon-quarter.
Plate two moon-quarters as a half moon.
cx: These craters are man-made. I can tell.
The crêpe is too thick. A crêpe should be see-through.
recipes.look: Grey-gold crêpes with tiny bubble craters, folded into quarters, oozing strawberry and chocolate, a cream 'cloud'.
recipes.anim: Crater bubbles pop on the crêpe surface during the sauté (decal flipbook).
recipes.vfx: Moon-dust puff when plated.
recipes.mut: Kitchen Pro on the delicate crêpe; Space Chef on the alien cheese chop; `MUT_279` Tiny Moons customers point at it proudly (bark).

recipes.name: Martian Meatloaf
recipes.desc: Rusty-red Martian Mince meatloaf with a ketchup glaze, served on a mashed-potato 'red planet' with a tiny flag. Planted, claimed, devoured.
steps: Loaf pan: ING_MARTIAN_MINCE loaf, ING_KETCHUP glaze.
Bake the ING_MARTIAN_MINCE loaf (ING_EGG, ING_PANKO, ING_ONION, ING_KETCHUP glaze) on MED.
Mash planet, loaf slice on top, tiny flag planted.
cx: The flag is upside down. Mars will hear about this.
Grandma's meatloaf was redder. And she was from Venus.
recipes.look: A thick rusty-red slice with a glossy glaze on a dome of mashed potato, a tiny flag stuck in the top.
recipes.anim: The flag waves although there's no wind (cosmetic loop).
recipes.vfx: Red dust puff on plating.
recipes.mut: Space Chef helps the alien mince prep; Spark Blend on both mixes; `MUT_033` Alien Grey Head customers hum the anthem of Mars (bark).

recipes.name: Nebula Nachos
recipes.desc: Chips baked under melted Moon Cheese, smothered in cheese sauce and swirled with glowing Nebula Salsa. Every chip is a tiny galaxy; every crunch is a supernova.
steps: Bake ING_TORTILLA_CHIPS under ING_MOON_CHEESE on MED until it glows.
Platter: ING_TORTILLA_CHIPS with ING_MOON_CHEESE, ING_BEANS, ING_CHEESE_SAUCE, ING_NEBULA_SALSA swirl, ING_JALAPENO, ING_SOUR_CREAM.
cx: The nebula is too small. Nebulae are VAST.
My chip went supernova all over my shirt.
recipes.look: Triangle chips under pale glowing cheese with swirls of purple-blue twinkling salsa like a galaxy.
recipes.anim: Salsa swirl slowly rotates (texture scroll); twinkles pulse.
recipes.vfx: Glow Guide shimmer on the salsa; star particles.
recipes.mut: Glow Guide (`glow` parts) on the glowing salsa; Space Chef on the alien chop; `MUT_138` Cosmic Nebula Body customers see their reflection (bark).

recipes.name: UFO Saucer Pancakes
recipes.desc: Two pancakes float-cooked in the Anti-Gravity Wok into perfect flying saucers with blueberry 'landing lights', drizzled with syrup that falls UP.
steps: Float-cook the ING_FLOUR saucers (with ING_EGG, ING_MILK, ING_BLUEBERRY); nudge them into a slow spin.
ING_FLOUR saucer, ING_BLUEBERRY landing lights, ING_FLOUR saucer, ING_ANTIGRAV_SYRUP drizzled upward.
Plate hovering 0.2 studs above the plate.
cx: The syrup fell DOWN. That's just regular syrup!
These saucers aren't flying, they're hovering. Different licence.
recipes.look: Two stacked domed pancakes shaped like flying saucers with a ring of blue berry lights and amber syrup streaming upward.
recipes.anim: Saucers hover and rotate slowly; syrup strands rise (inverted drip, texture scroll).
recipes.vfx: Small tractor-beam cone of light under the plate (Reduced Effects: static glow).
recipes.mut: `MUT_166` Alien Tractor Arm chefs earn a 'nice beam' bark; Space Chef widens the FLOAT window; Sweet Tooth on the syrup mix.

recipes.name: Comet Kebab
recipes.desc: Icy Comet Chunks skewered with peppers, onion, mushroom and pineapple, grilled and then float-spun in the Anti-Gravity Wok so the skewer trails a sparkling tail across the table.
steps: Cut ING_COMET_MEAT into chunks; cube ING_BELL_PEPPER, ING_ONION, ING_MUSHROOM and ING_PINEAPPLE.
Skewer: ING_COMET_MEAT, ING_BELL_PEPPER, ING_ONION, ING_COMET_MEAT, ING_MUSHROOM, ING_PINEAPPLE.
Grill the ING_COMET_MEAT skewer with its ING_BELL_PEPPER, ING_ONION, ING_MUSHROOM and ING_PINEAPPLE; turn once.
Float-spin the ING_COMET_MEAT skewer until the tail sparkles; nudge it straight.
Plate on rice with a ING_NEBULA_SALSA streak.
cx: The tail is short. My comet needs a LONG tail.
It melted a little. Comets are supposed to be icy!
recipes.look: A long skewer of glowing blue chunks and colourful veg trailing a sparkle tail, on white rice with a purple salsa streak.
recipes.anim: Skewer hovers and its sparkle tail follows it when carried (Trail on the prop).
recipes.vfx: Sparkle trail (Beam/Trail) — Reduced Effects: short static tail.
recipes.mut: `MUT_228` Comet Tail (`ABL_046` Comet Blink is combat-only) chefs get a 'family' bark; Space Chef on FLOAT and the alien chop; Hot Hands on the grill.

recipes.name: Asteroid Rock Candy
recipes.desc: Asteroid Sugar cooked into a candy syrup with a rainbow streak, then crystallised into a lumpy cluster of edible space rocks. Mostly crunchy. Entirely legal.
steps: Cook ING_SUGAR with ING_ASTEROID_SUGAR to the crystal point.
Streak: ING_ASTEROID_SUGAR syrup, then ING_RAINBOW_SYRUP (two folds only).
Plate the meteor cluster on sticks.
cx: This asteroid wouldn't even scratch a planet.
Too crunchy! My jaw has left orbit.
recipes.look: Lumpy grey-violet crystal clusters with a rainbow vein, on wooden sticks, glittering.
recipes.anim: Crystals slowly rotate on their sticks (prop tween).
recipes.vfx: Crystal glints and a tiny meteor streak on serve.
recipes.mut: Cold Snap / `ABL_067` Freeze Touch crystallises it instantly; `MUT_135` Golem Rock Body customers ask if it's a cousin (bark).

recipes.name: Glorp Stew
recipes.desc: Teal Glorp simmered with Martian Mince, Glowshrooms and root vegetables. It says 'glorp' when stirred and 'GLORP!' when perfect. Zorp's grandmother's recipe, allegedly.
steps: Cube ING_POTATO and ING_CARROT; slice ING_GLOWSHROOM.
Wake the ING_GLORP (gentle stir until it says 'glorp').
Brown ING_MARTIAN_MINCE with ING_GLOWSHROOM; two tosses.
Simmer ING_GLORP with ING_POTATO and ING_CARROT in ING_BROTH; stir — listen for 'GLORP!' at Perfect.
Bowl: ING_GLORP stew, ING_MARTIAN_MINCE and ING_GLOWSHROOM, ING_HERBS on top.
cx: It said 'glorp', not 'GLORP'. Undercooked.
My grandmother's glorp glorped louder.
recipes.look: A deep bowl of teal, gently glowing stew with cyan mushrooms, orange carrot cubes and mince, bubbles forming 'glorp' text.
recipes.anim: Bubbles rise and pop with 'glorp' speech bubbles (decal flipbook).
recipes.vfx: Teal glow and bubble particles.
recipes.mut: Steam Team on the simmer; Glow Guide on the glowshroom; `MUT_134` Slime Body customers say 'glorp' back (bark).

recipes.name: Black Hole Bagel
recipes.desc: A boiled bagel baked under Black Hole Seeds, then spun in the Anti-Gravity Wok until its hole becomes an event horizon. The galaxy cream cheese swirls toward the middle and never quite falls in.
steps: Bake ING_BAGEL crusted with ING_VOID_SEEDS on HIGH.
Spin ING_BAGEL in the wok until the hole turns into an event horizon; nudge it centred.
Slice ING_BAGEL in half (2 taps) — carefully, it pulls.
ING_BAGEL heel, ING_CREAM_CHEESE galaxy schmear with ING_GALAXY_GLAZE, ING_BAGEL top.
Plate; crumbs drift toward the hole.
cx: The hole isn't infinitely deep. I checked with my finger.
It ate my napkin. And my spoon. Can I have my spoon back?
recipes.look: A dark bagel studded with black glinting seeds, a swirling purple cream spiral spinning toward a jet-black hole that bends the light around it.
recipes.anim: Crumbs and nearby napkin props drift toward the bagel's hole (cosmetic client tween), then pop back.
recipes.vfx: Lensing ripple around the hole (Reduced Effects: dark ring decal).
recipes.mut: `MUT_070` Black Hole Mouth customers consider it a rival (bark); Space Chef widens the FLOAT window; Glow Guide on the seeds.

recipes.name: Mutagen Meatballs
recipes.desc: Four meatballs sautéed with Glowshrooms, then pumped full of lime Mutagen Goo in the Infuser. One bite and the customer sprouts a random cosmetic mutation for a minute. Whoa.
steps: Brown ING_MEATBALL in ING_TOMATO_SAUCE with ING_GLOWSHROOM.
Infuse ING_MEATBALL with ING_MUTAGEN_GOO; keep pressure 50–75 until they glow green.
Plate with a 'may cause whoa' sticker.
cx: I got Bunny Ears. I wanted Dragon Wings. Again!
The mutation wore off. Can I have another meatball? For science?
recipes.look: Four neon-green-glowing meatballs on spaghetti in red sauce with glowing mushroom slices.
recipes.anim: After ANM_043 the customer plays ANM_065 Mutation equip flex as a random cosmetic part pops on (client-only, 60 s).
recipes.vfx: Green swirl poof on the customer when the part appears (Reduced Effects: small poof).
recipes.mut: C10 rule: random cosmetic part for 60 s + Whoa! bonus. Space Chef widens the INFUSE window; `MUT_277` Orbiting Meatballs chefs add a fifth orbiting meatball (cosmetic).

recipes.name: Morph Smoothie
recipes.desc: A colour-cycling Morph Berry smoothie infused with Mutagen Goo. Drink it and watch your own ears turn into something else for sixty glorious seconds.
steps: Blend ING_MORPH_BERRY, ING_YOGURT, ING_BANANA and ING_ICE.
Infuse the ING_MORPH_BERRY smoothie with ING_MUTAGEN_GOO until it cycles colours.
Pour the ING_MORPH_BERRY smoothie into the beaker cup.
cx: It turned me into a fish for a minute. Ten out of ten. Do it again.
The colours stopped cycling. Is it broken or just tired?
recipes.look: A tall beaker cup whose smoothie cycles purple → green → orange, with a twisty straw.
recipes.anim: Customer sips, freezes, then ANM_065 flex as a cosmetic part appears.
recipes.vfx: Colour-cycling glow on the cup; poof on the customer.
recipes.mut: C10 rule: random cosmetic part for 60 s + Whoa! bonus. Spark Blend speeds the blend; Space Chef on INFUSE.

recipes.name: Shapeshifter Sushi
recipes.desc: Steamed Shapeshift Fish infused with mutagen and rolled with rice: every piece morphs into a different silhouette on the plate. So does the customer, briefly.
steps: Steam ING_SHAPESHIFT_FISH on the second tray.
Slice ING_SHAPESHIFT_FISH, ING_AVOCADO and ING_CUCUMBER into strips.
Infuse the ING_SHAPESHIFT_FISH strips with ING_MUTAGEN_GOO.
ING_SEAWEED, ING_RICE, ING_SHAPESHIFT_FISH, ING_AVOCADO, ING_CUCUMBER; roll.
Cut into 8 pieces (each picks a new shape).
Plate in a circle with ING_SOY_SAUCE.
cx: Piece four turned into a square. Piece four was supposed to be a star.
I grew gills for a minute. Fantastic. Where's my refund for the gills?
recipes.look: Eight sushi pieces that slowly morph between star, heart, fish and cube silhouettes on a round plate.
recipes.anim: Pieces morph silhouettes every 2 s (mesh swap tween); customer ANM_065 flex on the mutation pop.
recipes.vfx: Shimmer between morphs; green poof on the customer.
recipes.mut: C10 rule: random cosmetic part for 60 s + Whoa! bonus. `MUT_077` Chameleon Eyes and `MUT_255` Chameleon Skin customers morph in sync (bark); Steam Team on both trays.

recipes.name: Chimera Casserole
recipes.desc: Patchwork Chimera Chunks (part beef, part chicken, part fish, all delicious) infused with mutagen and baked under potatoes and cheese. Every forkful is a different animal; every customer becomes a slightly different one.
steps: Cube ING_CHIMERA_CHUNKS and ING_POTATO; slice ING_ONION and ING_MUSHROOM.
Brown ING_CHIMERA_CHUNKS with ING_ONION and ING_MUSHROOM.
Casserole dish: ING_POTATO, ING_CHIMERA_CHUNKS, ING_ONION, ING_MUSHROOM, ING_CORN, ING_MILK, ING_CHEESE crust.
Bake ING_POTATO, ING_CHIMERA_CHUNKS, ING_CORN, ING_MILK and ING_CHEESE on MED.
cx: My bite was chicken, then fish, then confusion.
I got a Scorpion Tail. I'm keeping it. (I can't keep it.)
recipes.look: A golden-crusted casserole square with visible patchwork layers (beef-red, chicken-cream, fish-white stripes) and green glints.
recipes.anim: Customer ANM_065 flex as a random cosmetic part appears; the casserole crust crackles.
recipes.vfx: Green swirl poof; patchwork shimmer on the layers.
recipes.mut: C10 rule: random cosmetic part for 60 s + Whoa! bonus. Customers whose morph mixes four or more categories (§12) get a 'relatable' bark; `ABL_061` Extra Hands bridges four stations.

recipes.name: Evolution Burrito
recipes.desc: Evolution Beans boiled, then infused until they sprout tiny legs, wrapped with Chimera Chunks, rice and fixings, and seared shut. It evolves while you eat it. So do you, cosmetically, for exactly one minute.
steps: Infuse ING_EVOLUTION_BEANS with ING_MUTAGEN_GOO until they sprout bow ties.
ING_TORTILLA, ING_RICE, ING_EVOLUTION_BEANS, ING_CHIMERA_CHUNKS, ING_AVOCADO, ING_CHEESE, ING_SALSA; roll.
Sear the ING_TORTILLA roll shut; flip once.
cx: It evolved into a quesadilla halfway through. I ordered a BURRITO.
I got Moth Wings. Moth Wings! I've never been happier and I'm furious it ends.
recipes.look: A seared burrito with tiny bean legs poking out of the ends, wiggling; green glow seams.
recipes.anim: Burrito changes silhouette three times while eaten (taco → burrito → wrap, prop swap); customer ANM_065 flex on the mutation pop.
recipes.vfx: Evolution sparkle spiral; green poof on the customer.
recipes.mut: C10 rule: random cosmetic part for 60 s + Whoa! bonus. Space Chef on INFUSE; Hot Hands on the sear; `ABL_061` Extra Hands handles the double boil.

recipes.name: The Golden Patty Supreme
recipes.desc: A Golden Patty grilled with a crosshatch and infused with Stardust until it hums like a choir, stacked with Moon Cheese, crispy bacon and gold leaf in a toasted bun. Restaurants have been named after less.
steps: Shred ING_LETTUCE; slice ING_TOMATO and ING_ONION rings.
Fry ING_BACON and ING_ONION rings together; shake once.
Grill ING_GOLDEN_PATTY; flip and Turn for crosshatch.
Crisp ING_MOON_CHEESE into a lacy disc (no flip).
Infuse ING_GOLDEN_PATTY with ING_STARDUST; hold 50–75 until the choir hums.
ING_BUN heel, ING_KETCHUP golden sauce with ING_MAYO, ING_LETTUCE, ING_TOMATO, ING_GOLDEN_PATTY, ING_MOON_CHEESE, ING_BACON, ING_ONION, ING_GOLD_LEAF, ING_BUN crown.
Plate under the golden cloche; lift on arrival.
recipes.sat: Legendary dish order: awards RT on serve (C4.1; amount per §22)
cx: The choir hummed slightly flat. I have perfect pitch.
The gold leaf is crooked. Do you know who I am? I'm a customer!
recipes.look: A tall burger with a gleaming gold patty, lacy pale cheese, bacon, gold-leaf crown and a soft sparkle halo, revealed under a gold cloche.
recipes.anim: Cloche lift with a spotlight beam; nearby customers turn heads (ANM_041 glance) and some clap.
recipes.vfx: Golden sparkle halo and a choir 'aaah' (audio); Reduced Effects: static halo.
recipes.mut: `MUT_039` Golden Burger Head, `MUT_178` Golden Chef Hands and `MUT_258` Golden Skin (gold) chefs get a royal bark; Kitchen Pro and Hot Hands on three grill steps; Space Chef on INFUSE.

recipes.name: Dragon Feast
recipes.desc: A feast fit for a dragon (no dragons were harmed — they were invited): Phoenix Ember Rice, a crosshatched Sea Monster Steak, grilled chicken and corn, Stardust-roasted potatoes, Dragon Pepper ember glaze and a Royal Dragonfruit sauce.
steps: Cube ING_POTATO; slice ING_DRAGON_PEPPER (it puffs smoke rings); cube ING_DRAGONFRUIT_ROYALE.
Roast ING_POTATO dusted with ING_STARDUST on HIGH.
Steam ING_PHOENIX_RICE until it flickers like embers.
Grill ING_CHICKEN and ING_CORN; flip the chicken.
Ember glaze: sauté ING_DRAGON_PEPPER; two tosses.
Blend ING_DRAGONFRUIT_ROYALE into a glowing sauce.
Feast platter: ING_PHOENIX_RICE, ING_SEA_MONSTER_STEAK, ING_CHICKEN, ING_CORN, ING_POTATO, ING_DRAGON_PEPPER glaze, ING_DRAGONFRUIT_ROYALE sauce.
Plate on the dragon-scale platter; two hands, deep breath.
recipes.sat: Legendary dish order: awards RT on serve (C4.1; amount per §22)
cx: Not enough smoke rings. A dragon would be ashamed.
I'm only one dragon. This is a feast for at least four dragons. I'll manage.
recipes.look: A huge dragon-scale platter: ember-flickering golden rice mound, crosshatched teal steak, grilled chicken and corn, sparkly potatoes, glossy red pepper glaze and a glowing magenta sauce.
recipes.anim: Smoke rings puff from the pepper glaze (FX loop); party customers do a synced cheer (ANM_064 Level-up celebrate repurposed as a cheer).
recipes.vfx: Ember sparkles (no flames), smoke rings, magenta glow; Reduced Effects: fewer particles.
recipes.mut: `MUT_031` Dragon Head, `MUT_238` Dragon Wings and `MUT_037` Phoenix Head chefs earn a 'family dinner' bark; Hot Hands on six heat steps; `ABL_061` Extra Hands is near-essential.

recipes.name: Infinity Pizza
recipes.desc: Infinity Flour dough float-stretched into a figure-eight, layered with galaxy glaze, three cheeses from two planets, pepperoni and charged Stardust, baked into a pizza with no beginning and no end. Every slice leads to the next slice.
steps: Float-stretch the ING_INFINITY_FLOUR dough into a figure-eight; nudge it level.
Charge the remaining ING_STARDUST until it twinkles.
Coin ING_PEPPERONI; slice ING_MUSHROOM; cube ING_MOON_CHEESE and ING_FANCY_FROMAGE.
ING_INFINITY_FLOUR figure-eight, ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_GALAXY_GLAZE, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_FANCY_FROMAGE, ING_MOON_CHEESE, ING_PEPPERONI, ING_MUSHROOM, ING_STARDUST sparkle.
Bake the ING_INFINITY_FLOUR pizza with ING_TOMATO_SAUCE, ING_GALAXY_GLAZE, ING_MOZZARELLA, ING_FANCY_FROMAGE, ING_MOON_CHEESE, ING_PEPPERONI, ING_MUSHROOM and ING_STARDUST; spin twice.
Slice along the loop into 8 endless slices (4 taps).
Plate on the infinity tray and lay the ING_GOLD_LEAF at the crossover.
recipes.sat: Legendary dish order: awards RT on serve (C4.1; amount per §22)
cx: I reached the end. There shouldn't BE an end.
I've been eating for an hour and I'm on slice one. Is that the point?
recipes.look: A figure-eight pizza with a deep-space glaze, pale moon-cheese crescents, pepperoni planets, twinkling stardust and gold leaf at the loop's crossing.
recipes.anim: Slices seem to regrow at the loop crossing (texture scroll illusion) while the customer eats.
recipes.vfx: Infinity sparkle running along the loop; star twinkles (Reduced Effects: static).
recipes.mut: `MUT_138` Cosmic Nebula Body and `MUT_168` Cosmic Chef Arm (cosmic) chefs: Space Chef on FLOAT and INFUSE; Many Hands on the 9-layer build.

recipes.name: Kraken King Banquet
recipes.desc: Three grilled Kraken Tentacles crowned with a Royal Pearl glaze over ink-black Kraken rice, surrounded by lobster-ish, steamed shrimp and fish, and crispy calamari. The tentacles wave; the whole restaurant bows.
steps: Slice ING_TENTACLE into rings; wedge ING_LEMON.
Grill three ING_KRAKEN_TENTACLE across both slots; flip and Turn.
Cook ING_RICE in ING_KRAKEN_INK until midnight-black.
Royal butter: sauté ING_BUTTER until nutty.
Pearl glaze: melt ING_ROYAL_PEARL, then fold in ING_STARDUST.
Banquet: ING_RICE, ING_KRAKEN_TENTACLE crown, ING_ROYAL_PEARL glaze, ING_LOBSTERISH, ING_SHRIMP, ING_FISH_FILLET, ING_TENTACLE rings, ING_BUTTER, ING_GOLD_LEAF, ING_LEMON.
Plate on the throne platter; requires two carriers or a carry-boosted chef.
recipes.sat: Legendary dish order: awards RT on serve (C4.1; amount per §22)
cx: Only three tentacles? A king has EIGHT.
The pearl glaze is merely magnificent. I expected transcendent.
recipes.look: A throne-shaped platter: midnight-black rice mound, three gold-rimmed violet tentacles arching into a crown with pearl glaze, ringed by pink shrimp, white fish, lobster-ish chunks and golden calamari, gold leaf and lemons.
recipes.anim: Three tentacles wave in a royal sequence (prop bones); party customers bow (ANM_053 Apologize bow reused as a bow of respect).
recipes.vfx: Pearl shimmer, gold sparkles and bubble trails (Reduced Effects: shimmer only).
recipes.mut: `MUT_038` Kraken Head, `MUT_137` Kraken Core and `MUT_165` Kraken Tentacle Arm chefs earn a 'long live the king' bark; carry-boost parts carry it solo; Sea Legs on every seafood heat step.

recipes.name: The Mystery Morph Meal
recipes.desc: Morph City's final dish: a Golden Patty in an Infinity Flour bun with Dragon Pepper, a float-spun Kraken Tentacle, Phoenix rice crunch and Moon Cheese fondue, all brought together by a Mystery Morph Essence sauce. Nobody knows what it tastes like. Everybody agrees it tastes like winning.
steps: Bake the ING_INFINITY_FLOUR bun on HIGH.
Float-spin ING_KRAKEN_TENTACLE until it curls into a crown; nudge it centred.
Fondue: ING_MOON_CHEESE, then a pinch of ING_STARDUST.
Mystery sauce: infuse ING_MYSTERY_ESSENCE with ING_MUTAGEN_GOO; hold 50–75 while it changes colour.

ING_INFINITY_FLOUR bun heel, ING_MYSTERY_ESSENCE sauce, ING_GOLDEN_PATTY, ING_MOON_CHEESE fondue, ING_DRAGON_PEPPER, ING_PHOENIX_RICE crunch, ING_KRAKEN_TENTACLE crown, ING_GOLD_LEAF, ING_INFINITY_FLOUR bun crown.
Plate under the question-mark cloche; reveal with a drumroll.
recipes.sat: Legendary dish order: awards RT on serve (C4.1; amount per §22); the finale dish of the Legendary Chef Tournament storyline (`EVT_005`, §20)
cx: It tasted like... everything? I wanted SOMETHING.
I'll need to order it again to be sure. And again.
recipes.look: A towering burger-like masterpiece: shimmering bun, gold patty, molten moon-cheese, crimson pepper, a violet tentacle crown and colour-shifting sauce dripping down, under a question-mark cloche.
recipes.anim: Cloche reveal with drumroll; the whole dining room pauses (customers ANM_041 glance) then cheers; Chef Supreme Omnivora (`NPC_029`) cameo bark when served during `EVT_005`.
recipes.vfx: Colour-cycling aura, gold sparkle, question-mark confetti (Reduced Effects: aura only).
recipes.mut: `MUT_280` Mystery Fog and `MUT_040` Glitch Head (secret) wearers get a unique 'it knows me' bark; Space Chef, Hot Hands, Kitchen Pro and Many Hands all apply — this is the kitchen's final exam.
